question: Claude Haiku dying in 3 months?
resolution_criteria:
Criteria

Resolves YES, if, before October 17:

no new Haiku is released (newer than Haiku 4.5)

OR

Haiku doesn't appear anymore on the Claude web app

Context

Haiku is going to be deprecated.

Sonnet is going to be the Haiku.

Opus is going to be the new sonnet.

And Fable the new premium Opus.

- An internet user, somewhere
research:
I've confirmed the key primary source and am now writing up the findings, leaving out anything dated after 2026-09-27.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no URL. In practice two things decide it: Anthropic's model announcements (anthropic.com/news, docs model list) and the model picker in the Claude web app (claude.ai).
- Structure: the question resolves YES if, before Oct 17, **no** Haiku newer than 4.5 is released, **or** Haiku disappears from the web app. So NO requires both a new Haiku release before Oct 17 and Haiku still showing in the web app. One ambiguity: if a new Haiku replaces 4.5 in the picker, a strict reading of "Haiku doesn't appear" might not apply, because some Haiku would still be visible.
- 2026-09-22: Anthropic's official Opus 5.5 post says "Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5" are coming "in the coming weeks" and will bring many of the same performance, efficiency and safety improvements. It gives no specific date. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5)

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-09-27)
- Haiku 4.5 is still the newest Haiku. Haiku 5.5 has been announced but not released, and I found no release date.
- I found nothing on or before 2026-09-27 saying Haiku has been removed from the Claude web app.
- Nothing settles the question yet. The key uncertainty is whether Haiku 5.5 ships before Oct 17, roughly 3.5 weeks after the Sep 22 "coming weeks" statement.
- The Claude 5 generation (Opus 5, Sonnet 5) shipped without a Haiku, so the line goes from Haiku 4.5 straight to the announced 5.5. X posts had predicted a Haiku 5 for August or September, and that did not happen. This comes from secondary trackers I could not fully date-check. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(AI)), [timeline](https://github.com/jqueryscript/anthropic-claude-timeline)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-23: Taiwanese coverage of the Opus 5.5 launch (the page didn't load, so this rests on search snippets) reports that Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 have not launched and will arrive "in the coming weeks". [technews.tw](https://technews.tw/2026/09/23/anthropic-upgrades-claude-with-new-opus-5-5-model/)
- 2026-09-22: Opus 5.5 is released as the first Claude 5.5 model. It reportedly costs about 40% less than Opus 5 ($4/$20 per million tokens) and roughly matches "Claude Fable 5.1" on most tasks. So the "Fable" premium tier mentioned in the question's context is real. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5), [gori.me](https://gori.me/?p=170548), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/claude-opus-5-5-is-here-7-things-developers-should-know-before-using-it-80ede01fc1d4)
- Before 2026-09-22: digg items describe Opus 5.5 "in stealth testing". [digg](https://digg.com/ai/2i38tn81)
- I could not find an Anthropic statement on or before 2026-09-27 about deprecating Haiku in the consumer app.

## 4. Base rates
- Past Haiku releases: Claude 3 Haiku (Mar 2024), Claude 3.5 Haiku (Oct 2024, about 4 months after 3.5 Sonnet), Haiku 4.5 (2025-10-15, about 2 weeks after Sonnet 4.5 on 2025-09-29, and about 5 months after Sonnet 4). [Anthropic timeline tracker](https://hidekazu-konishi.com/entry/anthropic_claude_model_release_timeline.html), [technews.tw Haiku 4.5](https://technews.tw/2025/10/17/anthropic-introducing-claude-haiku-4-5/)
- How fast Anthropic delivers on "coming weeks": in Oct 2024, 3.5 Haiku was announced alongside the new 3.5 Sonnet as coming "later this month" and shipped about 2 weeks later (early Nov 2024 in the API). Haiku releases have sometimes slipped past the stated timing.
- Historically, Haiku has followed the lead model by anywhere from 2 weeks to 5 months. Here the gap to Oct 17 would be 25 days after the Opus 5.5 announcement.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a related market, "Will a new Claude Haiku model be released...", by dbohdan. The page would not load through the proxy, so I could not get its price or exact criteria. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/dbohdan/will-a-new-claude-haiku-model-be-re)
- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market on a Haiku release date.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Sonnet 5.5 is expected first, since Anthropic listed it before Haiku 5.5. If Sonnet 5.5 ships soon, a Haiku 5.5 release before Oct 17 becomes more plausible.
- Haiku 5.5 itself is promised "in the coming weeks" from 2026-09-22, with no date. Watch anthropic.com/news, the @claudeai X account, and the API model docs.
- Anthropic could also announce changes to the claude.ai model selector, such as removing Haiku 4.5 or swapping in 5.5. That would bear on the second YES condition and on how "Haiku doesn't appear" is read.
- Resolution date is about 2026-10-08, but the criteria cutoff is "before October 17". A release between Oct 8 and Oct 16 may be relevant depending on when the question is actually resolved.

Sources: [Anthropic Opus 5.5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5), [technews.tw Opus 5.5](https://technews.tw/2026/09/23/anthropic-upgrades-claude-with-new-opus-5-5-model/), [gori.me](https://gori.me/?p=170548), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/claude-opus-5-5-is-here-7-things-developers-should-know-before-using-it-80ede01fc1d4), [digg](https://digg.com/ai/2i38tn81), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(AI)), [GitHub timeline](https://github.com/jqueryscript/anthropic-claude-timeline), [Konishi timeline](https://hidekazu-konishi.com/entry/anthropic_claude_model_release_timeline.html), [technews.tw Haiku 4.5](https://technews.tw/2025/10/17/anthropic-introducing-claude-haiku-4-5/), [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/dbohdan/will-a-new-claude-haiku-model-be-re)
